opening.argument: The description invites viewers to join OneCoin, while the walkthrough directs them through account completion and document uploads so they can trade the purported coin. The presenter specifically describes “uploading the KYC to be conditionally approved to sell OneCoin” and instructs viewers to provide “your ID your passport a good clear photo,” presenting these steps as platform verification. The process also reaches financial account information, with the displayed form containing an IBAN/Account Nr. field. These are not instructions to surrender existing passwords or recovery phrases, but they support participation in the documented OneCoin cryptocurrency-selling operation, which the U.S. Department of Justice identifies as fraudulent.
